meta_description: Corsers Plastering Services in Birmingham. Expert interior and exterior plastering, rendering, and skimming. Free quotes, reliable local tradesman.
hero_subhead: From new builds to renovation work, we deliver smooth, long-lasting finishes that stand the test of time.
services_subhead: Whether you need internal wall finishing, external rendering, or specialist repair work, we've got the skill and experience to get it right.

services.title: Interior Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Smooth, flawless wall and ceiling finishes ready for decoration. We work fast without compromising quality, leaving your rooms ready to paint within days.

services.title: Exterior Rendering
services.desc: Durable external finishes that protect your property and look professional. We specialise in pebbledash, smooth render, and textured coatings that resist Birmingham's weather.

services.title: Plasterboard Installation
services.desc: Stud walls, partition walls, and ceiling boarding fitted to building regulations. Ideal for loft conversions, extensions, and room reconfiguration.

services.title: Patch Repairs & Remedial Work
services.desc: Damaged plaster, cracks, and water-damaged walls fixed professionally. We match existing finishes seamlessly so repairs blend in invisibly.

services.title: Artex Removal & Replacement
services.desc: Remove outdated Artex safely and install modern plaster finishes. Perfect for updating older properties and preparing walls for contemporary décor.

services.title: New Build & Extension Plastering
services.desc: Full first-fix and finish plastering on new properties and extensions. We work to timescale, keeping your project on track from frame to decoration.

about_pullquote: I built this business on honest work and getting every finish right first time.
about_para_1: Corsers Plastering Services has been serving Birmingham homes and building sites for over 15 years. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a reliable local firm trusted by homeowners, builders, and contractors alike. We've completed over 1,000 projects across Birmingham and the surrounding areas—from small patch repairs to full new-build specifications.
about_para_2: We're known for turning up when we say we will, doing the job properly, and leaving your property clean. Our customers come back because they know they'll get a professional finish, fair pricing, and no surprises. We take pride in every wall we finish, whether it's a quick repair or a major renovation project.

reviews.text: Had Corsers in to do the whole front of the house after water damage. Kevin was professional, tidy, and got it finished on time. The render looks perfect and he kept disruption to a minimum. Really pleased with the work. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Called for emergency plaster repair after our ceiling started cracking. Same-day response, very reasonable quote, and the job was done beautifully. You can't tell where the repair is. Great local tradesman, will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Sarah K.

reviews.text: Corsers plastered two bedrooms for us during our loft conversion. Really meticulous work, clean site every day, and finished bang on schedule. The walls are perfectly smooth and ready for paint. Would have them back in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: David L.
